title: Dare I say- the theatre event of the fall?  Seriously cannot get over...
transcript: If you consider yourself a theater fan or theater kid, you simply have to go see the show. I am, of course, talking about Mama. I'm a Big Girl now. This is a new concert review type show featuring Kerry Butler, who you might know from Beetlejuice or Mean Girls, Lara Bell Bundy, who you probably know from legally Blonde, and Marissa Jaret Winokur, who is most well known for originating the role of Tracy Turnblad in Hairspray and winning a Tony for that role. All three of these women were in the original cast of Hairspray. So while it's kind of billed as a mini hairspray reunion concert, and they do sing a bunch of Hairspray, they are also singing songs from across all of their respective careers. So if you are a fan of Kerry Butler from Beetlejuice, you will get to hear her sing some Beetlejuice. If you are a fan of Laurabel Bundy from Legally Blonde, you will get to hear her sing an entire legally blonde medley. They truly sing all of the songs that you want them to sing, and even some that you didn't know you want them to sing. Like, did you know that you want a Carrie Butler Lara Bell Bundy duet of for good from wicked? Because I didn't know until it was happening right in front of me. And I was just sitting there and all like, oh, my god, this is the greatest thing I've ever seen. And Along the way, we also get to see each of these three women reflect on their career as well as their journeys as mothers. And that was the thing that I wasn't really expecting, because amidst this killer set list, you also have all of these deeply personal stories that give the show a ton of heart. So while I came in a fan of each of these performers, I came out an even bigger fan and also a greater appreciation for each of them as artists and as women. But this is truly one of the greatest times I have had in a theater all year. It's just a delight. I did not stop smiling the entire show, and I truly cannot recommend it enough.
